name: @agentic-toolkit/search
description: Reusable, configurable document-search view for the agentic-developer-hub. Two seams: a per-document-type result+preview renderer registry (markdown today), and an injected search SCOPE/source (base URL + endpoint paths + query-param mapping). Self-contained: ships its own compiled Tailwind stylesheet so marketing apps that do not scan @agentic-toolkit/ui still get the utilities.
comment:files: `dist` carries the JS + the COMPILED `dist/styles.css` (built by `build:css` via the Tailwind CLI). Unlike @agentic-toolkit/markdown/ui/themes — which ship hand-written src CSS — this package's `./styles` is a Tailwind BUILD over its own components AND the @agentic-toolkit/ui components it composes, so a marketing app (which deliberately does not @source node_modules/@agentic-toolkit/ui) still gets the needed utility classes. The export points at the compiled dist file, so `dist` is the only path needed.
comment:exports: `development` → src for `next dev` (HMR of the COMPONENT logic, no build/restart); prod skips it → dist. Mirrors @agentic-toolkit/markdown. NOTE: `./styles` resolves to the COMPILED `dist/styles.css` in both dev and prod (it is a build artifact, not source CSS), so editing a component's utility classes needs a `build:css` to refresh it.

scripts.build: tsup && pnpm run build:types && pnpm run build:css
